scenes.head: E‑invoicing is only for big companies?
scenes.say: Myth or fact? E-invoicing in the UAE is only for big companies.

scenes.desc: deadline to appoint an Accredited Service Provider. Implement by 1 July 2027.
scenes.src: Source: Ministerial Decision No. 244 of 2025, Art. 5(1)(b), mof.gov.ae; checked 29 Oct 2026. B2C‑only businesses are outside the system until a further Ministerial decision. Valorin is an independent advisory firm, not affiliated with the FTA or MoF.
scenes.say: Myth. In-scope businesses with revenue below fifty million dirhams must appoint an accredited service provider by the thirty-first of March, twenty twenty-seven, and implement by the first of July, twenty twenty-seven.
Check your invoice data and your E.R.P. first, so you know what to ask providers. Then appoint one before the thirty-first of March.

scenes.disc: General information only, not legal or tax advice. Valorin is an independent advisory firm, not affiliated with the FTA or MoF. Valorin is not an ASP.
scenes.say: Valorin is not an A.S.P. We help with the gap assessment, provider selection support and E.R.P. integration. General information only, not legal or tax advice.
